name: SignalSight Conversion API
author: signalsight

sections.description:
SignalSight Conversion API is your ultimate solution for streamlining zero and first-party data to ensure resilient and reliable signals. Seamlessly integrate your tracking setup with WooCommerce and enable events like PageView, AddToCart, Purchase, and more.

This plugin allows:
– Advanced tracking for e-commerce events like ViewContent, AddToCart, Purchase, and Checkout.
– Basic PageView tracking for non-eCommerce websites.
– Full support for configuring PII (Personally Identifiable Information) tracking like Email, Phone, and more.
– Effortless integration with SignalSight’s platform.

Perfect for marketers and developers aiming to optimize their conversion tracking.

sections.installation:
1. Download and extract the plugin files.
  2. Upload the signalsight-conversion-api directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the SignalSight Conversion API settings page to configure your P2S key, Base URL, and event tracking preferences.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

WooCommerce is only required for advanced e-commerce tracking events like AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, and Purchase. For corporate or non-eCommerce websites, PageView tracking works without WooCommerce.

Can I configure my own PII data for tracking?

Yes! You can configure and manage PII data such as Email, Phone, and more directly from the plugin settings under the “Advanced Settings” tab.

What is the SignalSight P2S key, and where do I get it?

The P2S (Platform-to-Signal) key is your unique identifier for SignalSight integration. You can generate this key in your SignalSight dashboard.

Does this plugin support other platforms like Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat?

Yes, SignalSight integrates seamlessly with these platforms. Ensure your SignalSight account is set up for cross-platform tracking.
